subject: The apron at Bergamo Orio al Serio airport
creator: Air fans
alt_text: The apron at Bergamo Orio al Serio airport at dusk, with aircraft at stands and the terminal building behind them.
crop_notes: Closes the gap flagged in the first QA report. A photograph of THE AIRPORT, not of Bergamo city — the architecture document forbids the latter, and that rule is why the page went without one. Placed mid-page rather than in the hero so the drawn distance diagram remains the page's visual centre. A second candidate showing a prominently branded Ryanair aircraft filling the frame was rejected: it advertises a third party and says nothing useful about a transfer. NOTE on the accepted image: an airline livery is legible on an aircraft in the left background. That is incidental to a wide documentary apron view — any photograph of any apron contains liveries, and demanding none would make airport photography impossible. The rule targets images that advertise a third party or imply affiliation; this one does neither. The distinction from the rejected candidate is prominence, and it is recorded here so the two decisions can be compared.
